# Dev Ledger

> Dev Ledger is an open-source developer analytics application that turns GitHub history into a longitudinal record of source growth, activity patterns, languages, milestones, and project evolution.

Dev Ledger is available at https://devledger.site and its source is public at https://github.com/Aliferous3/dev-ledger. The hosted application authenticates through GitHub OAuth and a read-only GitHub App. Public product, legal, and security pages may be indexed and summarized. Authenticated application routes, API endpoints, and telemetry relays are not intended for crawling.

Key data-handling facts: Dev Ledger does not persist repository source code, commit messages, pull-request titles, GitHub email addresses, GitHub OAuth access tokens, GitHub App installation tokens, or raw webhook payload bodies. It stores GitHub-derived metadata needed to compute analytics and maintain sync state.

## Product

- [Dev Ledger](https://devledger.site/): Live application and product entry point.
- [Security & Privacy](https://devledger.site/security): Public trust record covering access, storage, authentication, isolation, controls, and recovery.
- [Privacy Policy](https://devledger.site/privacy): Privacy policy for the hosted service.
- [Terms of Service](https://devledger.site/terms): Terms governing use of the hosted service.
